---
title: GetRig
description: Player character rig access utility.
---

GetRig provides safe access to the standard R15 rig components from a player's character.

## Usage

```luau
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local GetRig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.GetRig)

local rig = GetRig(player)
if rig then
    -- Move character
    rig.root.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 10, 0)
    
    -- Play animation
    local track = rig.animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
    track:Play()
    
    -- Access character parts
    rig.char:FindFirstChild('LeftHand')
end
```

## API Reference

### `GetRig(plr: Player): Rig?`

Safely retrieves rig components from player character.

Returns `nil` if:
- Player has no character
- Character lacks `HumanoidRootPart`
- Character lacks `Humanoid`
- Humanoid lacks `Animator`

## Rig Structure

```luau
type Rig = {
    char: Model & {
        HumanoidRootPart: Part,
        Humanoid: Humanoid & { Animator: Animator },
        Head: Part,
        LeftHand: Part & { Grip: Motor6D },
        RightHand: Part,
        LeftFoot: Part,
        RightFoot: Part,
        LeftUpperArm: Part,
        RightUpperArm: Part,
        LeftLowerArm: Part,
        RightLowerArm: Part,
        LeftUpperLeg: Part,
        RightUpperLeg: Part,
        LeftLowerLeg: Part,
        RightLowerLeg: Part,
    },
    root: Part,              -- HumanoidRootPart
    hum: Humanoid,           -- Humanoid instance
    animator: Animator,      -- Humanoid's Animator
}
```

## Comparison with Client

| Feature | GetRig | Client module |
|---------|--------|---------------|
| Scope | Server/Client | Client only |
| Caching | None | Yes (respawn aware) |
| LocalPlayer | Any player | LocalPlayer only |

For client-side code that only needs LocalPlayer, prefer `Client` module:
```luau
local client = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.Client).init()
local root = client.root
```
